headerDisplay: iTach IP2CC Garage Door Opener. Controls garage doors through Global Caché iTach IP2CC contact-closure relays over TCP. Door position is inferred from travel timers and can optionally be corrected by an authenticated HTTP webhook.
footerDisplay: Wire the relay across your opener's wall-button terminals. See the [README](https://github.com/richdawson/homebridge-itach-garage-door#readme) for wiring, webhook setup, and safety notes.

name.title: Platform Name
name.description: Name shown in the Homebridge log for this platform.

doors.title: Doors
doors.description: One entry per garage door. Each entry maps a door to a single relay connector on an IP2CC.

name.title: Display Name
name.description: Name shown in the Home app. Truncated to 64 characters.

ipAddress.title: IP2CC IP Address
ipAddress.description: IPv4 address of the iTach IP2CC in dotted-quad notation.

relay.title: Relay Connector
relay.description: Which relay connector drives this door.

port.title: TCP Port
port.description: TCP port of the IP2CC Unified TCP/IP API. Leave at 4998 unless changed on the device.

doorId.title: Door ID
doorId.description: Stable identifier used in the webhook path /door/<doorId>/state. Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. Defaults to the door's position in this list.

pulseDuration.title: Pulse Duration (ms)
pulseDuration.description: How long the relay is held closed to simulate a wall-button press.

openingTime.title: Opening Travel Time (seconds)
openingTime.description: Time the door takes to travel fully open. Used to infer door position.

closingTime.title: Closing Travel Time (seconds)
closingTime.description: Time the door takes to travel fully closed. Used to infer door position.

midTravelBehaviour.title: Mid-Travel Behaviour

oneOf.title: Stop (a press while moving stops the door)
Reverse (a press while moving reverses the door)

midTravelBehaviour.description: What your opener physically does when the button is pressed mid-travel.

webhook.title: Webhook (optional)
webhook.description: Optional HTTP endpoint that lets an external source (such as a Home automation driven by a door sensor) correct the door state. Leave the port empty to disable.

port.title: Webhook Port
port.description: TCP port to listen on. Leave empty to disable the webhook.

bindAddress.title: Webhook Bind Address
bindAddress.description: Local address to bind. Use 127.0.0.1 to accept only local requests.

token.title: Webhook Authentication Token
token.description: Shared secret required in the X-Auth-Token header. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32
